newsitem.title: USA: PHLX delays launch of First USA Paymentech options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX delays launch of First USA Paymentech options.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange delayed the start of trading in options on First USA Paymentech Inc shares to Friday, April 18, from the originally planned launch date of Wednesday, April 16.
PHLX said exchange members would be notified of any changes in initial strike prices, which it said earlier in the week would be 20, 22-1/2 and 25.
The stock was up 1-3/8 at 23-1/2 in Wednesday's early afternoon trade.
Group One Ltd is to be the specialist for the options, PHLX said.
